title: Nonnegativity of the central binomial ratio
statement: For every nonnegative integer $j$, the central binomial coefficient divided by $2^{2j}$ is nonnegative: $\displaystyle 0 \le \frac{\binom{2j}{j}}{2^{2j}}$.
